ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Persistence Via DLLPathOverride
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when an attacker adds a new "DLLPathOverride" value to the "Natural Language" key in order to achieve persistence which will get invoked by "SearchIndexer.exe" process

sequences.query: (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\SYSTEM\\\\CurrentControlSet\\\\Control\\\\ContentIndex\\\\Language\\\\.*") AND (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\StemmerDLLPathOverride.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\WBDLLPathOverride.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\StemmerClass.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\WBreakerClass.*")))
